conceptual_delta: Replace exact-UID recall and one-hop negative controls with an actual LLM that can read all training examples, consolidate a text lesson, or consolidate and execute a bounded program. Qualify these controls before a canonical-revision efficacy occurrence.
task: Authored maintenance catalog from predecessor; supplied relation alphabet and same authored rule, not a new independent semantic task family.
shared_tool_surface: Each inference may emit either a UID set or a bounded Here/Traverse/Union/Intersect/Difference AST. All programs use the independently implemented comparator interpreter; no arbitrary model code is executed.
matching: Same configured model/identity tier/decoding and the same eight source examples. Same available call/output caps and program tool. ALL_TRAINING_HISTORY retains all examples; the two consolidation arms compress the same source. Actual prompt tokens and calls differ and must be reported; no equal-cost efficacy estimate or padding claim.
ordering: Consolidate text then program before calibration; rotate inference arm order by calibration task index. No calibration labels or scores returned to any model request.
outcome: Exact UID set against source catalog table-join oracle after all three predictions for the task are sealed. Oracle and generator share research author/process; no independent custody claim.
invalid_model_output: Retain as wrong/invalid in the arm denominator; no extraction of guessed JSON fragments, retries or human repair. Invalid consolidation disables that arm for all six tasks and keeps all six failures.
transport_or_identity_error: Stop occurrence with retained journal and INSTRUMENT_ERROR, no efficacy verdict. Unknown provider usage remains unknown; never assume zero cost.
fixed_model_boundary: Exact requested/reported model ID and optional deployment evidence are checked. Provider ID, seed, model list or fingerprint alone do not attest immutable weights or deterministic execution. Identity-only runs are explicitly exploratory.
stopping: One occurrence per frozen configuration/source seal. If any strong arm reaches 6/6, record SATURATED_FOR_INCREMENTAL_SUCCESS_TEST. If every strong arm is 0/6, record FLOOR_OR_INVALID. Otherwise record PARTIAL_HEADROOM_REQUIRES_NEW_INDEPENDENT_FAMILY. These are descriptive calibration rules, never G0/G1 promotion. Do not tune prompts or spend final holdouts after seeing scores.
reserved_data: No ALFWorld valid_unseen group or other final holdout is read or consumed. Calibration seeds are public, not blind or final holdout.
